summary: Iteration 12 — Verified F2F48 Studio v1.8.0 feature additions: passwordless admin auth, AI Text-to-Video engine toggle (Flux/Kling/Veo3/Pika) for Faceless mode, and one-click 'Render both aspects' (9:16 + 16:9 parallel). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests PASSED (auth + /studio/render/estimate cost scaling across all 4 engines matching expected $0.10/$1.02/$2.02/$0.82 + /studio/render/both-aspects shape with immediate force-delete cleanup). Frontend: live UI smoke on /studio confirmed all new testids (chip-ai-engine appears only when broll=ai/mix, AIEnginePicker modal shows 4 options, chip label updates after pick, hidden when broll=pexels). /scripts v1.8.0 page renders cleanly with all components (ResultsNavBar, SectionCard, platform pills with proper active-state contrast). ZERO compile-error overlays. ZERO real renders triggered (estimate-only backend + no clicks on generate-btn/generate-both-aspects-btn).

minor.issue: Response user object does NOT carry isAdmin field — only {email, entitlements}. isAdmin is only surfaced by GET /api/auth/me. Task spec claimed /auth/check should return isAdmin=true; either the spec is wrong or the endpoint should be extended to include it for symmetry with /auth/me. Currently a frontend consumer must call /auth/me after /auth/check to know admin status.

action_items: (Optional) Extend POST /api/auth/check response to include isAdmin on the user object — currently only /auth/me carries it; the task spec assumed /auth/check would also. Frontend currently calls /auth/me as a follow-up which works, so this is a nice-to-have not a blocker.

(Carried from iter 10/11) server.py is now ~2263 lines, well past the 700-line guideline. Split render pipelines (_run_render_avatar/faceless/composite) and T2V_ENGINES helpers into /app/backend/renders/*.py before adding more engines.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 2263 lines — urgent split needed; v1.8.0 added ~300 more lines (T2V_ENGINES, _fal_t2v_generate, _make_t2v_clip, both-aspects endpoint). Refactor recommended.

T2V_ENGINES cost_cents are ROUGH estimates (kling=50c, veo3=100c, pika=40c). Real fal.ai prices may vary; consider periodic validation against actual invoiced cost so the circuit breaker doesn't under-estimate.

estimate_render_cost_cents TTS coefficient (0.5c per 1k chars) still 10x too low per earlier iterations — at higher engine costs (veo3 = $2/clip) the script length is dwarfed but for many short t2v scenes this still matters.

/studio/render/both-aspects fires asyncio.create_task on insert — there's a small race where the background _run_render can begin before a fast bulk-delete completes. Admin force-delete should ideally also signal/cancel the task. Low-risk because both-aspects is admin-driven, but worth tightening.

context_for_next_testing_agent: v1.8.0 (AI engine toggle + both-aspects) is fully verified end-to-end. ZERO real renders were triggered — all backend tests used estimate-only, and the one both-aspects call used pexels (free stock) + immediate force-delete cleanup. The chip-ai-engine appears ONLY when at least one scene is source='ai' (via broll_source='ai'/'mix' or per-scene override). All 4 engines map to expected cost tiers: flux=4c/scene, pika=40c/scene, kling=50c/scene, veo3=100c/scene. Backend response from /api/auth/check does NOT include isAdmin in the user object (only /auth/me does) — spec was wrong on that detail but functionally fine since frontend calls /auth/me afterwards. NO blocking bugs. Recommend addressing the server.py size + estimate TTS coefficient before going live with real-render mode on the new t2v engines (a single misconfigured 12-scene veo3 render could approach $12).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. /auth/check missing isAdmin in user object is a minor spec mismatch (not a bug).
